segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן יַעֲקֹב אוֹמֵר: בְּהֵמָה גַּסָּה שֶׁשָּׁפְעָה חֲרָרַת דָּם, הֲרֵי זוֹ תִּקָּבֵר, וּפְטוּרָה מִן הַבְּכוֹרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya’akov says:» In the case of «a large animal that expelled a mass of» congealed «blood, that» mass «must be buried.» The reason is that perhaps there was a male fetus there which was consecrated as a firstborn when it emerged, «and» the animal «is exempt from» having any future offspring counted «a firstborn.»

moves.summary: Mass of blood buried; animal exempt from firstborn

positions.claim: the blood mass must be buried and the animal is exempt from firstborn status
